title: OctavianOS / Koronos Production Userspace Handoff Contract v2.0
description: Implements real CPL3 init with genuine syscalls, aligned with Linux ABI and proven init workflow
alignment: Linux kernel (5.10+), musl libc, systemd, glibc

address_space.verification: Kernel owns all PTEs, user has read-only access to own directory
address_space.alignment: Linux: cr3 per task_struct, CFI guard, SMAP/SMEP

privilege_entry.requirement: Real ring-3 trampoline (GDT user descriptors, TSS, RSP0)
privilege_entry.verification: IRET/SYSEXIT transition with canonical user stack address
privilege_entry.alignment: Linux x86-64: set_tss_desc, load_TR, LSTAR MSR

syscall_gateway.requirement: SYSCALL/SYSRET or interrupt gate at CPL 0
syscall_gateway.verification: SYSCALL from CPL3 enters verified kernel boundary

signal_delivery.requirement: Real POSIX signal delivery (SIGCHLD, SIGTERM, SIGKILL)
signal_delivery.verification: Signals delivered to CPL3, handler runs at CPL3, signal return via SIGRETURN
signal_delivery.alignment: Linux: signal frame layout, SA_RESTART semantics

step_1_cpl3_acknowledgement.action: Call getpid(), verify PID==1, emit CPL3 proof marker
step_1_cpl3_acknowledgement.evidence: Output appears in QEMU console / serial log
step_1_cpl3_acknowledgement.verification: Proves init is running at CPL3 with real PID

step_2_init_ready.action: Emit readiness marker after CPL3 proof
step_2_init_ready.evidence: Readiness marker in logs after CPL3 acknowledgement

step_3_filesystem_mount.action: Mount essential filesystems (proof of real syscalls)

step_4_parse_cmdline.action: Read kernel command line, find 'init=' target

step_5_fork_manager.evidence: Manager process visible in QEMU ps output

step_6_wait_manager.action: waitpid() for service manager to stabilize

step_7_idle_reaping.action: Infinite loop reaping children (normal init state)
step_7_idle_reaping.evidence: Init PID=1 in QEMU ps, no exit until shutdown

fork.implementation: Kernel clones process, returns child PID to parent and 0 to child

execve.signature: int execve(const char *path, char *const argv[], char *const envp[])
execve.implementation: Kernel loads ELF, replaces address space
execve.permissions: Loaded ELF must be readable executable
execve.return: Never returns on success, -errno on error

waitpid.signature: pid_t waitpid(pid_t pid, int *wstatus, int options)
waitpid.implementation: Kernel blocks until child exits or signal delivered
waitpid.WNOHANG: Return immediately if child not yet exited

mount.signature: int mount(const char *src, const char *tgt, const char *fstype, ulong flags, const void *data)
mount.implementation: Kernel mounts filesystem at target path

signal.implementation: Kernel registers signal handler for CPL3 delivery
signal.delivery: Signal interrupts CPL3 code, calls handler at CPL3, SIGRETURN returns

stage_2_init_ready.failure: Init reached but not ready (syscalls not working)

stage_4_service_manager.requirement: systemd/openrc running as PID 2, init in reaping loop
stage_4_service_manager.evidence: ps aux output shows init and manager

stage_5_child_reaping.requirement: No zombie processes, SIGCHLD handler active
stage_5_child_reaping.evidence: ps aux shows no <defunct> init children

stage_6_aurora_startup.gate: MUST PASS before Live image release

stage_7_six_target_matrix.requirement: Live + Installer + Recovery × BIOS + UEFI = 6 cases
stage_7_six_target_matrix.gate: MUST PASS all 6 before ISO release
stage_7_six_target_matrix.failure: One or more target/firmware combinations broken

init_process.octavian_approach: CPL3 init calls real syscalls, manages process tree, reaps zombies
init_process.difference: Octavian init is minimal init launcher, delegates to systemd/openrc
init_process.syscall_compat: Syscall numbers match Linux x86-64 (glibc/musl compatible)

filesystems.octavian: Mount devtmpfs, proc, sysfs, tmpfs in init
filesystems.linux: Same (done by early init or PID 1)

signal_handling.linux: POSIX signal delivery, handlers at CPL3

libc_integration.linux: Dynamic or static depending on distro
libc_integration.compat: octavian-init is self-contained, no runtime dependencies

known_limitations.single_init_target: Only one service manager executable at a time
known_limitations.no_multi_user: No per-user services, only system-wide targets
known_limitations.minimal_libc: musl is 2MB, glibc is larger - production may need more
known_limitations.no_cgroups: Process groups managed by kernel directly, no cgroups v1/v2
known_limitations.no_namespaces: No containers - Koronos may add later
